test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

(The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word.)

Cow ∶ Milk ∶∶ Sheep ∶ ?
solution:
**Logic :** Animal : Produces

__
 
• **Cow** produces **milk**.

Similarly,

 
• **Sheep** produces **wool**.

Hence, **"Wool"** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Wool → Produced by sheep
 
• Baby → Produced by human reproduction
 
• Silk → Produced by silk worms
 
• Clothes → Produced by various methods in textile and fashion industry.
